name: Petrol_Pedestal_Test_01

limits: Offline checks do not prove game loadability or successful physics.
Frame graph groups exclude component attachment and welded geometry.
Logic node indexes use the observed zero-based endpoint convention; omitted definition fields remain unknown.
No collision, watertightness, torque continuity, or spatial mating certification is performed.

systems.coolant: Engine outlet manifold 19 -> radiator inlet port 38 -> radiator 35 -> outlet port 39 -> pump inlet port 40 -> pump outlet port 41 -> engine inlet manifold 18.
systems.starter: Battery 67 / port 69 -> relay 71 ports 73/74 -> starter port 77 -> motor 6 -> pulley 10 -> belt -> engine wheel 2.
systems.fan: Battery port 70 -> relay 72 ports 75/76 -> fan port 80 -> radiator fan 36.

initial_state: RUN off, START released, throttle 0.15; no saved rotation/damage.
pump_order: Pump 8 ports 30 then 31; pump 9 ports 40 then 41 retained in source component order.
belt_signs: Engine wheel, starter pulley and accessory pulleys all reverse=true; positive accessory drive is a deduction from matching reversal settings.
limits: Saved/template geometry and static audits do not establish runtime mounting or circulation.

No output load, gearbox or instrumentation is added.
